title: Parcel locker collection
bodyMd:
The table covers parcels deposited during one week and collection by the stipulated deadline. Each parcel has a unique record.

| Category | Deposited parcels | Collected on time |
|---|---:|---:|
| Transit | 120 | 108 |
| Campus | 180 | 153 |
| Residential | 300 | 240 |
